# Axon 7 display: what the bootloader leaves running

The Axon 7 panel is a Samsung 1440x2560 AMOLED (`zte_samsung_5p5_wqhd_dualmipi_cmd`)
driven over **two DSI links in command mode**. A command-mode panel has its
own frame memory: it only shows a new picture when the MDP sends one. So a
plain "simple framebuffer" stays frozen on whatever was last sent unless
someone starts a frame.

## Layout found by the probe shim

ZTE LK sets up a continuous splash; `ios/shim/axon7-probe.c` dumped the MDP
state it leaves behind (MMU off, straight after LK):

```
buffer   0x83401000, 1440 x 2560, RGB888 (3 bytes/pixel, memory order B,G,R), stride 4320
VIG0     SRC0_ADDR 0x83401000, SRC_SIZE 720x2560, SRC_XY 0,0    -> LM0
VIG1     SRC0_ADDR 0x83401000, SRC_SIZE 720x2560, SRC_XY 720,0  -> LM1
CTL0     LAYER(LM0) = 0x1 (VIG0),  TOP 0x21f20 (command mode, INTF1)
CTL1     LAYER(LM1) = 0x8 (VIG1),  TOP 0x21f30 (command mode, INTF2)
LM0/LM1  OUT_SIZE 720x2560
PP0/PP1  ping-pong blocks for the two halves (tear check)
INTF1 -> DSI0 (0x994000) left half, INTF2 -> DSI1 (0x996000) right half
MDP_TOP  +0x2f4 SPLIT_DISPLAY_EN = 1
```

## Sending a frame

1. Update the pipe source (VIG0 and VIG1 `SRC0_ADDR` +0x14, `SRC_YSTRIDE0`
   +0x24, `SRC_FORMAT` +0x30, `UNPACK` +0x34). VIG1 keeps `SRC_XY` x = 720,
   so both pipes can point at the same full-width buffer.
2. Flush: CTL0 FLUSH (+0x18) bit 0 (VIG0) and CTL1 FLUSH bit 1 (VIG1); add
   bit 6/7 (LM0/LM1) and bit 17 (CTL) when the layer setup changed.
3. Write 1 to **CTL0 START (0x90201c)** only. With split display enabled
   this sends both halves; tested on the device, the kernel console filled
   the whole 1440-pixel width with only CTL0 started.
4. Wait for MDP `INTR_STATUS` (0x901014) bits 8 and 9 (PP0 and PP1 done),
   clear them by writing to 0x901018. Never START again while a frame is
   being transferred: that desyncs a command-mode panel.

Blanking without powering the panel down: set the CTL LAYER registers
to `BORDER_COLOR` (bit 24) with no pipes; black on an AMOLED is pixels off.

Brightness: DCS short write 0x51 with one parameter, from the DSI command
FIFO (CMD_DMA_TPG). The bootloader reports `broadcast=1`, so DSI0 is the
broadcast master.
